text: Great lets do the prune, since there is no harm in removing something that does nothing
resolution: Pruned the dead editor command surfaces as one coherent removal: fake Compile, 2D/3D switching, legacy Paint Material, Sample Material, unavailable Trigger/Spawn/Mission/Sequence/Pipeline commands, their keymap/menu/dispatcher branches, empty Story and Help menus, fake mission card, and pipeline/mission/routes selectors. Removed the unused availability schema and stale UI state, added hot-reload normalization for selections removed mid-update, and retained real Paint Faces, Map Paint, linked minimap, and future compile/marker concepts. Verified editor type-check, command suite 12/12, diff check, and full ReleaseFast editor ship.
